industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: ISA Energía Brasil S.A.
summary: Specializing in electric power transmission, ISA Energía Brasil S.A. operates throughout Brazil. By December 31, 2023, its substantial infrastructure encompassed an installed transformation capacity of 85,000 MVA, along with 23,000 kilometers of transmission lines, 32,000 kilometers of circuits, and 137 substations. The company's reach extends across numerous Brazilian states, including Alagoas, Bahia, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraíba, Paraná, Pernambuco, Piauí, Rio Grande do Sul, Rondônia, Santa Catarina, São Paulo, and Tocantins. Established in 1999, ISA Energía Brasil S.A. is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
